report:
Endometrium, curettings

Sections show a moderate amount of fragmented endometrium. Decidua and hypersecretory endometrium are present. Chorionic villi are present, confirming an intrauterine gestation. There is no evidence of chronic endometritis, hyperplasia or malignancy.

ENDOMETRIUM, curettings - PRODUCTS OF GESTATION confirmed; no evidence of hyperplasia, gestational trophoblastic disease or malignancy
